BiblicalUsage: Machatsith is the half, and it does steady work all through the law: the half shekel every numbered man gave in Exodus 30:13, rich and poor alike in Exodus 30:15, and the half of the spoil set apart for the priest in Numbers 31:29.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that God counts halves as carefully as wholes: nobody's share is too small to matter to Him.
